title: With the thumbs greyed on a stopped reply, Down from the answer should land on Retry and Left/Right should hold still
measured: 2026-09-16 about 04:40 local, build 0fbecb6 (hash-matched), Deck built-in screen, Main tab, Strategy mode, no game. A long Deep Rock Survivor guide was asked and stopped after about 500 characters with the Stop generation button; the turn shows 'Stopped — partial answer kept.' with Helpful and Not really greyed.
evidence: docs/test-evidence/plan56-GREYED-STEP-OVER-01-thumbs.json (the walk up into the answer, then Down, Left, Right)
docs/test-evidence/plan56-GREYED-STEP-OVER-01-thumbs-b.json (Down from the answer's last paragraph, twice)
what_happened: Up from Read aloud landed on the greyed Helpful button ('Mark reply helpful', class Disabled). The greyed button takes the ring from below.
Up from that button reached the answer's last paragraph, then the one before it.
Down from the answer's last paragraph: the first press moved nothing (a dead press); the second press landed on the greyed Helpful button, not on Retry.
Left from an answer paragraph moved the ring onto Steam's own Quick Access rail (the Decky tab), out of the plugin; Right brought it back onto the reply's container, fully covered by the dock.
verdict: FAIL on this build for the thumbs half: the greyed thumbs still take the ring from both directions, with a dead press first from above. Plan 55's fix (lane D, 'step over greyed Helpful / Not really') does not fire on a stopped live turn on this build.
also_found: Left from an answer paragraph leaves the plugin for Steam's rail: the same shape as the Ask button and paperclip bug from plan 55 (roadmap Bugs, one star, focus), now seen from inside a reply.

On the built-in screen the answer's paragraphs are only ever partly visible while the ring is on them: 33% (covered by the tab bar and off the top) and 67% (under the question box). The visible chat is 143 pixels, and a paragraph taller than that can never be shown whole; this is the geometry from plan56-M-internal-screen-layout.json, not a new focus bug.
settings_touched: none; the stopped turn stays in the two-turn Portal 2 chat, which now has three turns
